## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 (14/3)

## How it works

- [statement] Read concern available is an explicit exception to shard-filtered distinct scans: SERVER-92466 is titled "Don’t shard-filter distinct scans when read concern is available" and records a fix version of 8.1.0-rc0. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92466 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2
- [statement] MongoDB’s March 17, 2026 impact statement for SERVER-110803 says that affected 8.2.x versions expose the sort/group/top/bottom incorrect-results bug only when featureFlagShardFilteringDistinctScan is changed from its default true to false; it identifies 8.2.4 as a fixed version. This issue does not justify claiming default 8.2 shard-filtered DISTINCT_SCAN returns those incorrect results. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-17) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-110803 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-113145
- [statement] In r8.2.0, DISTINCT_SCAN can fetch documents internally. Its doWork invokes doFetch and increments docsExamined when needsFetch is set; SERVER-92459 explicitly moves fetching into this stage. Consequently, DISTINCT_SCAN without a separate FETCH node is insufficient evidence of index coverage. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/r8.2.0/src/mongo/db/exec/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92459

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The pre-fix $group DISTINCT_SCAN issue could select stale orphan values after updates or deletions. Apparent deduplication by group key could hide the error; selecting only one representative does not establish that it is an owned document. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-42160 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] SERVER-113145 documents a performance regression with featureFlagShardFilteringDistinctScan enabled: some $sort/$group pipelines with compatible $top/$bottom ordering choose IXSCAN or COLLSCAN instead of DISTINCT_SCAN. Its recorded fix version is 8.3.0-rc0; v8.2 is a backport request, not proof of an 8.2 patch fix. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-09) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-113145 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB tracks enabling shard-filtering DISTINCT_SCAN in 8.2.0-rc0 (SERVER-72748); the dependent correctness bug for $group DISTINCT_SCAN on sharded collections, SERVER-42160, is also fixed in 8.2.0-rc0. The implementation ticket itself landed earlier in 8.1.0-rc0, so implementation and default enablement are different milestones. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-05-22) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-72748 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-42160, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92453
- [statement] In r8.2.0, DistinctScan accepts a shard filter and can check ownership within the scan. Consequently, absence of a separate SHARDING_FILTER node does not by itself show that a DISTINCT_SCAN plan lacks ownership filtering. Inspect the scan flags. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/r8.2.0/src/mongo/db/exec/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92458, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92453
- [statement] DISTINCT_SCAN does not establish index-only execution. The r8.2.0 implementation records isShardFiltering and isFetching separately, and its internal fetch path increments docsExamined. A worked DISTINCT_SCAN example also has a FETCH parent and nonzero totalDocsExamined. Check fetching flags and document counters as well as the stage name. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/r8.2.0/src/mongo/db/exec/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://dev.to/mongodb/firstlast-per-group-postgresql-distinct-on-and-mongodb-distinctscan-performance-1e9d
- [statement] The r8.2.0 source explicitly distinguishes a shard-filtering scan that does not fetch: its index includes the shard key, and the constructor may install an orphan-chunk skipper. This permits filtering from index data, but the stage name alone does not establish that configuration or coverage of the entire pipeline. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/r8.2.0/src/mongo/db/exec/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2
- [statement] The 8.2 patch level matters independently of shard filtering: release notes list fixes in 8.2.2 for $group distinct scans on sparse indexes omitting null or missing results, including a related alternative-index case (SERVER-110423 and SERVER-111486). (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-11-19) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.2.md · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2
- [statement] The feature does not imply that all group-like pipelines gain DISTINCT_SCAN. SERVER-133187 states that the unwind/group optimization omitted sharded collections and remains unresolved in its August 10, 2026 record. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-10) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-133187 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2
- [statement] The feature-enabling task SERVER-72748 and the sharded sort/match/group/first improvement SERVER-55200 both identify 8.2.0-rc0 as their fix version. The shard-filtering implementation ticket SERVER-92453 identifies 8.1.0-rc0, so implementation and feature enablement have different version milestones. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-72748 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-55200, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92453
- [statement] For a DISTINCT_SCAN coverage investigation, inspect the stage fetching status and document examination statistics. The r8.2.0 implementation records isFetching from needsFetch and counts internal fetches in docsExamined, while shard filtering without fetching assumes the index includes the shard key. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/r8.2.0/src/mongo/db/exec/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92459
- [statement] DISTINCT_SCAN skips duplicate index keys using seeks, but its availability does not guarantee it wins. MongoDB tracks multiplanning DISTINCT_SCAN candidates for 8.2 and explicitly tests aggregate/distinct cases where IXSCAN should be selected instead. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-45689 · keywords: DISTINCT_SCAN with shard filtering in 8.2 · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-94493
